events.title: 왓퍼드 winger Nigel Callaghan moves to 더비 카운티 in a £140,000 deal.
UEFA confirms that the ban on English clubs in European competition that arose from the Heysel disaster will continue for at least another season.
에버턴 go top of the First Division with a 3–1 home win over 코번트리 시티. 레스터 시티 climb out of the bottom four with a 3–1 home win over 윔블던.
In a thrilling game between one side challenging for the title and the other battling to avoid relegation, 리버풀 beat 레스터 시티 4–3 at Anfield, with Ian Rush scoring a hat-trick.

게리 리네커 scores all four goals as England beat Spain 4–2 in a friendly in Madrid . England under-21s beat Spain 2–1 in a friendly in 부르고스 , with goals from 19-year-old 아스널 midfielder David Rocastle and 21-year-old 웨스트햄 유나이티드 striker Tony Cottee .
Billy McNeill boosts 애스턴 빌라's battle against relegation by paying 에버턴 £300,000 for their striker Warren Aspinall .

Third Division 위건 애슬레틱 , in only their ninth season as Football League members, reach the FA Cup quarter-finals for the first time in their history by beating 헐 시티 3–0 in the fifth round at Springfield Park . 리버풀 miss the chance to go level on points at the top of the First Division when they are held to a 2–2 draw at 애스턴 빌라.
Title-chasing 에버턴 are knocked out of the FA Cup 3–1 in the fifth round by 윔블던.
리버풀 sign midfielder Nigel Spackman from 첼시 for £400,000.

에버턴 finish February as First Division leaders, but only lead on goal difference over second-placed 리버풀. 아스널 are a point behind with a game in hand. 포츠머스, 더비 카운티, 올덤 애슬레틱, 플리머스 아가일 and 입스위치 타운 continue to lead the way in the Second Division.
